name: scenarios
description: Use this skill when a dataflow compares alternatives as scenarios, or when a task makes, reads or compares one. It says what a scenario's set, scenario-specific nodes, shared context and shared outcomes are, how a copy pairs with the scenario it comes from, how a chart stacks what each scenario's box hands it and colors it with the scenario chips, and how a scenario dragged in from another project names where it came from.
